categories.main_business_segments: Keysight Technologies operates through two primary business segments: the Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG). CSG serves commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government markets, while EISG focuses on automotive and energy, semiconductor, and general electronics markets. Each segment offers a mix of hardware, software, and services tailored to its end markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Keysight's core technologies include advanced electronic measurement and test instrumentation, proprietary semiconductor and packaging technologies, and a software-centric approach to integrating hardware and software into application-specific solutions. Manufacturing is a mix of in-house production for high-value, complex components and contract manufacturing for assembly and printed circuit boards, with centralized manufacturing in Malaysia and technology centers in the US and Germany.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse global customer base across more than 100 countries, including Fortune 1000 companies, original equipment manufacturers, contract manufacturers, network equipment manufacturers, government agencies, automotive OEMs and suppliers, semiconductor companies, and electronics design teams. Key end markets include communications, aerospace and defense, automotive, energy, industrial, general electronics, and semiconductors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Keysight operates globally with significant presence in the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Major facilities and operations are located in the United States, Malaysia, Japan, China, Germany, India, United Kingdom, Taiwan, Spain, Korea, Singapore, Romania, and France. Over 70% of revenue is generated outside the US, reflecting broad international reach.
categories.supply_chain_position: Keysight primarily operates downstream in the supply chain, providing test and measurement solutions, software, and services to companies developing, manufacturing, and deploying electronic products and systems. The company sources components globally and leverages both in-house and contract manufacturing, positioning itself close to end customers and product commercialization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include investing in differentiated, first-to-market solutions, expanding in attractive adjacencies, growing recurring revenue through software and services, and disciplined capital stewardship. R&D focuses on enabling technologies, system design, simulation, and measurement, with significant investment (about 16% of revenue) in innovation areas such as 5G/6G, AI, quantum, automotive electrification, and cybersecurity. Recent acquisitions have broadened capabilities in simulation, security, and RF/microwave instrumentation.
categories.revenue_model: Keysight generates revenue primarily through the sale of hardware products, software licenses and subscriptions, and a broad portfolio of services including support, calibration, and professional services. Increasing emphasis is placed on recurring revenue from software and services, including SaaS and enterprise software subscriptions, as well as multi-year service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with a range of global and regional firms in the electronic test and measurement industry, including companies with substantial sales, marketing, and R&D resources. Keysight differentiates itself through technology leadership, breadth of solutions, and scale, claiming no competitor matches its full range of offerings across all served markets. Notable competitors include Rohde & Schwarz, Tektronix (Fortive), National Instruments (Emerson), Anritsu, and specialized regional players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2024, Keysight reported $5.0 billion in revenue, down from $5.5 billion in 2023, with net income of $614 million. The company has a global workforce of approximately 15,500 employees and a market capitalization of about $20 billion as of April 2024. While recent results reflect macroeconomic headwinds and lower demand, Keysight maintains a strong balance sheet, robust cash generation, and a long-term growth outlook driven by secular technology trends.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Keysight emphasizes its ability to accelerate customer innovation and time-to-market through industry-leading, first-to-market solutions that integrate hardware, software, and services. Its value proposition is built on deep customer relationships, unique technology expertise, broad and configurable solutions portfolio, and a resilient business model. Differentiation is further supported by proprietary technologies, vertical integration, and a focus on enabling customers to address complex engineering challenges in rapidly evolving markets.
